summary: Use border-only composer focus and shared success-only copy feedback for answers and Markdown code.

compatibility.detail: Focusing a composer no longer outlines the frame; only its 1px border turns to the 40% accent. Successful answer/code copy shows a check, a polite Copied announcement and a Copied tooltip for 1.5 seconds. Host copy callbacks must complete only after the real copy succeeds. Recipient and model menus use the shared composition selection surfaces.
